title: Agent-led help: /yoke help and planned yoke-global help
name: Agent-led help: /yoke help and planned yoke-global help
audience: Human asking an agent, with the agent selecting the right deeper instruction
scope: Project help inside a wired project; global help outside one
trigger: User asks how to use Yoke, invokes help, or needs a missing-project recovery path
current: /yoke help exists and prints a broad generated skill table plus terminal recipes. yoke-global is planned in FIRST-USER P4, not established here as shipped.
proposed_purpose: Translate the person’s intent into one useful action and its canonical instructions.
content: If the user gave a task, answer that task with one recommended route.
If they asked generally, offer a short choice: start a project, plan work, run work, check progress, review a decision, or get unstuck.
Name where the action belongs: this project folder, another project folder, or the global session.
Explain only the unfamiliar term needed for that action.
Offer the relevant manual section and exact skill/help pointer when more detail is wanted.

scope_variants.outsideProject: Show accessible projects or create/add a project; carry the chosen intent into the actual folder before /yoke onboard or item execution.
scope_variants.insideProject: Use current project facts and the item’s pinned workflow to route; do not require the user to memorize stage commands.

authority_and_reuse: The skill is a router to canonical skill bodies, docs and generated command reference, not another command catalog or a second set of operating rules.
proposal_status: Modify existing project help; planned global skill carries the global variant
